regression_sweep.surface: spread strip: open spread 1, the cover, then spread 1 again (strip-1, strip-0)

album list: back to albums (36 items), open the first album

deviations.what: The given says one mouse.wheel(0, 255) sets a zoom of about 0.6. In this browser it set 0.5286, because the wheel deltaY reaches the page scaled by 1.25 (Windows display scale): exp(-255 x 1.25 x 0.002) = 0.5286.
deviations.why: 0.5286 is still between the whole-photo zoom (0.3366) and 1, so the covered-axis falsifier stays discriminating. The contract's 'about 0.6' assumes a device scale of 1.

deviations.what: The given says desktop Chromium with hasTouch. The probe drives the existing Playwright MCP context, so touch was enabled with CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled (maxTouchPoints 5), which is the call Playwright's hasTouch option makes. The pinch itself was driven with CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent and two touch points, as the contract says.
deviations.why: A new context with hasTouch would leave the console and network capture of the MCP tools.
